name: mluk-work-agent-tools
description: Shared Claude Code tooling for team projects: repository bootstrap, project estimation, and Jira workflow.

plugins.name: project-bootstrap
plugins.description: Initialise or audit a repository's agent harness: AGENTS.md, skills, commands, hooks, MCP, docs. Stack-agnostic.

plugins.name: estimation
plugins.description: Estimate a project from a spec and a design handoff: decomposition, provenance audit, markdown report and the company estimate workbook.

plugins.name: jira-workflow
plugins.description: Create and run Jira work the way the company standard requires: issue hierarchy, description shape, statuses, comments, worklog.
